key_idea: The key's teeth must match the keyhole's teeth in size and place.
steps: Look at the keyhole. Next to the round part there is a wide, long tooth. Further out there is a thin, shorter tooth.
The key needs the same teeth in the same places.
Key B has a wide, long tooth first and a thin, shorter tooth after it.

choice_feedback.A: It has only one tooth, but the lock needs two.
choice_feedback.C: Its teeth are swapped: the wide tooth is short and the thin tooth is long.
choice_feedback.D: It has 3 small teeth, but the lock has 2.
choice_feedback.E: Both of its teeth are too short.
